criteria.interpretation: Supports public research/management relevance only; it does not establish buyer demand or validate the linked evidence source.
criteria.rule: A location-specific rationale and public evidence URL are recorded for candidate screening.

criteria.interpretation: A balanced candidate frame is not a representative sample of either region.
criteria.rule: Eight U.S. and eight international candidate AOIs use the same nominal 625 km² footprint and OPERA DSWx-S1 V1 metadata window.

criteria.interpretation: Metadata discovers possible acquisition dates; it says nothing about valid pixels, floodwater, or event matching.
criteria.rule: Report complete CMR metadata-hit and distinct-date counts for the same product/window; do not convert metadata to observations.

criteria.interpretation: RTC is a separate availability diagnostic, not OPERA DSWx-S1 validation or event/baseline coverage.
criteria.rule: Report the pinned 12-group-per-area 2025 Sentinel-1 RTC finite/non-nodata VV sample and its 80% spatial-coverage floor.

criteria.interpretation: Groundsource dates do not establish official event occurrence, exact time, QA-valid imagery, or independent labels.
criteria.rule: Report news-derived event leads and metadata-date opportunities as discovery counts only.

criteria.interpretation: An affected administrative polygon intersecting an AOI does not locate inundation within the AOI or provide an independent pixel label.
criteria.rule: Keep official event reports and administrative-area overlaps as separate, source-linked event context.

criteria.interpretation: No area currently satisfies the confirmatory gate; all remain candidates or exploratory leads.
criteria.rule: Require verified event-specific coverage, at least three QA-valid scenes in each event and baseline period, full-AOI and asset coverage review, independent licensed labels, probability sampling, and the predeclared precision gate.

interpretation_limits: Public evidence supports documented local research or management context, not ATLAS market demand or purchase intent.
CMR rows and dates are metadata discovery, not retrieved or QA-valid OPERA observations.
RTC VV checks are a separate Sentinel-1 archive availability diagnostic and are not water labels or OPERA DSWx-S1 validation.
Groundsource is news-derived event discovery; dates and geometry require independent official verification.
Nonzero reference-lead counts mix sources with different dates, sensors, classes, licenses, and sampling adequacy; they do not mean a site passes validation.
All areas remain unconfirmed until the same scene-quality, independent-label, sampling, precision, and licensing gates pass.
Jakarta's January 2026 event-area context is an administrative-boundary intersection screen; it does not count as an independent reference label or confirmatory observation.
